chunks: O believers, respond to the call of God and His Prophet when he calls you to what will give you life (and preservation). Remember that God intervenes between man and his heart, and that you will be gathered before Him.

key_terms.بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَ قَلْبِهِ: Between the man and his heart

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for God to intervene between a man and his heart in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-habl* (the barrier) between the individual and their heart, illustrating how divine will or internal disposition can obstruct spiritual receptivity. It underscores the necessity of aligning one's heart with the call of the Prophet and the Imams, as true life (*hayat*) is found in heeding this guidance. The mention of being gathered to God serves as a reminder of accountability for those who respond versus those whose hearts are veiled.
